description: Sixteen faders with sixteen voltage outputs, modelled on the 16n hardware controller, which also serves as a parameter expander for teletype

params.text: Sets the voltage on the output below it, over whichever range the menu has chosen

outputs.text: The voltage of the fader above it
The voltage of the sixteenth fader, or all sixteen fader voltages on one polyphonic cable when polyphonic mode is on

notes: placed immediately beside a teletype, this becomes a parameter expander: the FADER operator reads its sixteen faders as whole numbers from 0 to 16383, whatever voltage range is set here.
to drive these faders from a 16n or another MIDI controller, pick the device on the MIDI connection submenu. The default mapping is continuous controllers 32 to 47 on channel 1.
menu: Fader voltage range: 0-10V, 0-5V, +/-5V — sets the range every fader covers
Fader size: 90mm, 60mm — sets how long the faders are drawn, the shorter setting leaving room below them for labels
Polyphonic mode — turns the sixteenth output into a polyphonic cable carrying all sixteen fader voltages
MIDI connection — chooses the MIDI driver and device the faders follow
Autodetect 16n configuration — interrogates a connected 16n for its controller and channel mapping and matches the faders to it; with none present it resets to controllers 32-47 on channel 1
